rows.label: Tenet Livia
rows.note: random element and 25-60% bonus; both reroll every 4 days at 0:00 UTC

disclosures.title: Valence Fusion toward 60%
disclosures.body: Optional; the bonus rolls between 25% and 60%; stop at the first usable roll. Fusion gives 1.1 times the higher bonus, rounded down and capped at 60%. A result of 58% or more becomes 60%, so a donor at 52.8% or better finishes it. Start from the Tenet Livia you want to keep. Its Catalysts, Forma, Exilus adapter, Focus lens, and Elemental Vice stay; the donor's are lost. A second copy costs another 40 Holokeys and a 4-day wait. Elemental Vice swaps the bonus element only on a rank 40 weapon (5 Forma). It does not change the percentage. Fusion lets you pick which of the two elements survives.
